CivicOps SOS alerts your municipality\'s control room. In a life-threatening emergency always call 10111 (police), 10177 (ambulance/fire) or 112 from a cell phone. No responder is contacted automatically; a named human decides every safety and dispatch action.
Address or landmark (if location is unavailable)
Silent SOS for a threat situation (no on-screen alarm)
Hold the button for 3 seconds to confirm. Releasing early cancels without sending an alert. Location is requested only after SOS and expires after 30 minutes or when resolved.
Hold for 3 seconds to activate SOS
SOS is active. Share a landmark or location only for this alert’s bounded follow-up window.

Tokens are encrypted with an Android Keystore key. Job drafts live in this app’s private storage; backups are disabled. Sign-out clears cached work and unsent drafts. Pending items expire after seven days. Municipal MDM, device encryption and remote wipe require owner deployment.
Sign out and clear this device’s private cache

Status, notes and photos queue offline with unique idempotency keys. Conflicts require your review before retrying against the latest version. Location drafts are discarded when sharing stops, a shift ends or consent is withdrawn.
